title: spec: list_datasets answers a term with no match with a `candidates` list, never selected; ADR-0149 D3 gains the amendment note
body:
repo:objectstack#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzgh1zkZzDXL36ckWAG

立卡门类别：④ 协调节点的子单，承父单 objectstack-ai/objectstack#34659（MCP 二期与问数专题）；#34691 裁定后的执行卡，⛔ 不是认领。
Ruling: F1 B, #34691 comment 6943126855, option text verbatim 「B 零命中返回候选」 — 「现在就改服务器，list_datasets 零命中时返回候选数据集。专题席的新推荐。」, knocked to #34659 as comment 6943149235. It re-rules E2 of #34659 comment 6940528935 from "B with a premise" to A.

## 维护者速读

- **做什么**：`list_datasets` 的返回结构加 `candidates`：用户的词一个成员都没精确命中时，列出相近的成员，只供反问，平台永不替用户选。
- **为什么**：今天零命中时客户端只能自己猜；候选放进工具结果，任何客户端都读得到，不靠技能措辞。
- **同卡**给 ADR-0149 D3 加修订说明：「什么算命中」不变；有候选先反问，没有候选才按第 4 条回退。
- **需要你做的**：PR 含 `docs/adr/**`，是 Tier H，要你亲手合并；没有别的要决定。

## 现状 (objectstack `origin/main` f6f5b50a05, read 2026-11-17; code read, nothing run)

- `ListDatasetsOutputSchema` is `datasets`, `partial`, `warning` (`packages/spec/src/ai/dataset-tools.zod.ts:168-178`); `matches` is per dataset, equality hits only (`:161-164`, `:84-93`). Nothing answers a zero-match.
- With `terms` the whole admitted catalogue is still returned (`packages/services/service-analytics/src/dataset-tools.ts:389-451`): a zero-match gets every dataset and no pointer to the near ones.
- ADR-0149 D3 rule 1 already lets a substring or neighbour "be offered in rule 3's question, never acted on"; rule 4: no hit falls back (`docs/adr/0149-ai-answers-business-questions-through-the-dataset-semantic-layer.md:151,154`). M1 A keeps AI guidance text out of the spec (`dataset-tools.zod.ts:38-39`).

## 要做的

- `ListDatasetsOutputSchema` gains optional `candidates`. Proposed; the PR settles it and says why if it differs:
  - entry `{ term, dataset, member, matchedOn }`: `DatasetTermMatchSchema` plus the dataset;
  - present only when `terms` were sent and a term hit no member of any listed dataset, for those terms only; absent otherwise, so an answer with a hit is unchanged;
  - order: terms as sent, datasets as listed, measures before dimensions (D3 rule 5); no score;
  - cap: an exported per-term constant (proposed 5);
  - `.describe()`: not a match, for a clarifying question, never selected, only members this caller may read.
- Spec tests (`dataset-tools.test.ts`); regenerate `packages/spec/*/ai.json` and `content/docs/references/ai/dataset-tools.mdx`.
- ADR-0149 add-only note under D3, in ADR-0011:238's `> **Amendment note**` form: hits unchanged; a term with no hit gets `candidates`; with candidates the caller asks in rule 3's form and acts on none; with none, rule 4 unchanged. It names rule 4 too: asking before the fallback changes the path, not the matching.

## 不做的

- The near-match rule, executor and tool description: the server sibling.
- Skill text (#34685), `/mcp/skill` (#34686), the cloud planner; any change to `matches` or normalization.

## 验收

- The schema parses answers with and without `candidates`, today's unchanged; generated files committed; spec tests green.
- The ADR note is add-only.

Governed: `docs/adr/**` is Tier H (`scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs:1375`). Its add-only arm reads S only beside riders; `packages/spec/**` keeps this PR Tier H, landed by the maintainer's hand.

Reader: `domain:spec` · seat 3 area o3-E, L1-c review.
Blocked-by: none.
Dedupe: `gh api -X GET search/issues -f q='repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue list_datasets candidates'` → 10 (#34685, #34691, #34659 open; #32072 and QA runs closed; none this). `… ADR-0149 D3 near` → 2 (#34691, #34659).
